items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I met him, I knew why. He was the biggest Benson fan

ctx.x: it was me playing. So they figured I was a white guy. I was in a store one time, getting ready to buy some strings and guitar picks. I was playing right down the street, in Washington, D.C. These two guys, white guys, they were talking. They said, “What’s at the club this week?” They said, “It’s a guy named George Benson.” They said, “Who is it?” They said, “It’s a white guy. He plays like Howard Roberts.” I said, WHAT?, to myself. I stood there and grinned a little bit, but I couldn’t let them know that I knew…
